skill.name: Cut "and then... and then" and repeated words
skill.why: Repeats make readers drift off. Cut them and every word earns its place.
skill.how: Spot the repeat. Cut it or swap it. Check every event and detail survived.

beats.say: This draft keeps saying and then. Readers get bored.
beats.show: We ate **and then** we swam **and then** we slept.

beats.say: Cut the extra joins. Keep every event.
Repeated words drag too. Spot the one that keeps coming back.
Swap the second one for it. Same meaning, less drag.
Last check: did every event survive? Then the edit works.

creature.name: Snipwing
creature.blurb: A ghost bat that hunts in the volcano's lava tubes by listening to its own echo. Every 'and then, and then' bounces round its cave, so it snips the extras off.
